lines: - AI\
An AI that a person instructs, such as Claude Code, which leaves work to overnight before night.
- plugin maker\
One who makes another plugin, such as rn, and lets overnight carry its unattended work.
- O1: the AI gets the work it left before night done by morning, while nobody answers.
- O2: the plugin maker's plugin carries each piece of its unattended work past the usage limit.
- KR1.1: the share of the night's pieces whose whole result the AI can't take in by morning.
Lower is better.
- KR1.2: the steps the AI takes to leave the night's work and to take in its results. Fewer is
better.
- KR2.1: the share of the plugin's pieces stopped by the usage limit that never reach their end.
- O1: the AI gets the work it left before night done by morning, while nobody answers.
- O2: the plugin maker's plugin carries each piece of its unattended work past the usage limit.
overnight carries each piece left to it to its end, waiting out the usage limit, with nobody there.
- A start at the set time, for O1\
- Nothing to answer, for O1\
- Several pieces at once, each waiting on its own, for O1\
- A piece that can't finish given up, for O1\
- A morning record of each piece, for O1\
- The same waiting for other plugins, for O2\
